data.summary: The diagnose directory contains the intelligent diagnosis agent framework, providing deterministic evidence gathering, fault-injection evaluations, regression testing, and LLM/rule-based diagnostic tools for data pipeline alerts.

file_insights.name: __init__.py
file_insights.detailed_description: Placeholder initialization file for the diagnose package.

file_insights.name: __main__.py
file_insights.summary: Main CLI entry point for the diagnosis agent.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines the DDL for diagnosis storage and provides main CLI functionality to diagnose pipeline alerts.
file_insights.detailed_description: Main entry point for running the diagnosis agent via command line. Parses arguments, executes diagnostics, and stores results into the database.

file_insights.name: evidence.py
file_insights.summary: Deterministic checks and evidence gathering mechanisms for diagnostics.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains deterministic check functions, health/delivery probes, and classification rules for pipeline diagnostics.
file_insights.detailed_description: Provides deterministic checks, checklists, and evidence gathering functions for the diagnosis agent. Implements rule-based classification and playback/recording mechanisms.

file_insights.name: faults.py
file_insights.summary: Fault-injection evaluation framework for validating diagnostic accuracy.
file_insights.source_summary: Provides fault injection utilities and test scenarios to validate accuracy of various diagnostic arms.
file_insights.detailed_description: Implements fault-injection evaluation framework to test the diagnosis agent against real pipeline failures and known root causes.
responsibilities: Verifying agent diagnosis against expected causes
Managing test fixtures and state restoration

file_insights.name: regress.py
file_insights.summary: Regression testing runner against recorded diagnostic fixtures.
file_insights.source_summary: Implements regression runner using recorded fixtures from faults to ensure consistent agent behavior.
file_insights.detailed_description: Runs regressions of the diagnosis agent against recorded evidence fixtures without touching live resources.
responsibilities: Evaluating model and rule arms safely

file_insights.name: tools.py
file_insights.summary: Read-only tools used by the diagnosis agent for pipeline inspection.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines langchain tools for inspecting runs, querying SQL, reading landing files, and checking service health.
file_insights.detailed_description: Implements read-only tools for the diagnosis agent including run inspection, SQL execution, landing file readers, and Docker status checks.
responsibilities: Database and container inspection for agents
